Signals cost, throughput, and lead-time improvements that can lift margins and delivery reliability.
More output from existing assets can improve operating leverage without major capex.
Unit cost reductions expand gross margin if pricing holds and mix is stable.
Improves dealer service and could accelerate revenue recognition.
Execution could convert existing demand to shipments faster, aiding cash and revenue.
